title: Mag Debowler
description:
Mag Debowler
This handy little tool makes removing your spent herb from herb chambers like the dynavap an effortless task. it also has a magnet in the centre which makes taking the cap off your dynavap a breeze.
The mag debowler is constructed out of solid anodised aluminium with steel pokers. it also has a rubber base to prevent it slipping around your table.
Included
1 x Mag Debowler
